about: The location and prop sheet is React (src/components/SubjectSheet/SubjectSheet.jsx renders the modal frame; engine.js, moved verbatim by tools/extract-engine.js, draws the sheet). tools/split-map.js drops the code and modal below. Core still holds SS (the sheet state core reads) and ssSection (the music chunk uses it); the sheet mode and slotUpload are the character sheet's (src/components/CharacterSheet, which provides them). The engine reaches all of them through its bridge. PROVIDED: openSubjectSheet (the Locations and Props cards) and renderSubjectSheet (core's plate and view tools repaint the open sheet).
